_comment: Server-sent message text (e-mail, SMS). {placeholders} are filled by the server. Never put patient names here; the patient's name is only added by the hospital connector.

staffInvite.subject: You are invited to NeuroCapture for {hospital}
staffInvite.body:
You have been added to NeuroCapture for {hospital} as {role}.

Set your password here (the link works once and expires in {days} days):
{link}

After that you will set up two-step sign-in with an authenticator app.

patientInviteEmail.subject: {hospital} invites you to record movement tests at home
patientInviteEmail.body:
{hospital} has invited you to record short movement tests at home with the NeuroCapture app.

Open this link on your phone, or scan the QR code attached (it works once and expires in {days} days):
{link}

You will then choose a PIN. You do not need your MRN.

patientInviteSms.body: {hospital}: record your movement tests at home with NeuroCapture. Open {link} (works once, {days} days).

reminderEmail.subject: {hospital}: please record your movement tests by {due}
reminderEmail.body:
{hospital} asks you to record your movement tests in the NeuroCapture app by {due}{appointment}.

Open the app, choose {hospital} and tap Start recording.

reminderSms.body: {hospital}: please record your movement tests in the NeuroCapture app by {due}{appointment}.

staffReset.subject: Reset your NeuroCapture sign-in for {hospital}
staffReset.body:
Your NeuroCapture sign-in for {hospital} was reset by {by}.

Choose a new password here (the link works once and expires in {hours} hours):
{link}

After that you will set up two-step sign-in with your authenticator app again.

If you did not ask for this, tell your hospital admin.

testEmail.subject: NeuroCapture test e-mail from {hospital}
testEmail.body:
This is a test from {hospital}'s NeuroCapture connector. E-mail to patients is working.

No reply is needed.

accountCode.subject: Your NeuroCapture code: {code}
